correction_to_sequence_96.previous_overstatement: Sequence 96 described gauntlet-loop too strongly as a public executable control plane.
correction_to_sequence_96.corrected_statement: At the audited revision it is a substantial typed/tested control-plane library and workflow substrate, but the declared CLI does not expose the campaign/experiment/evaluate/promote/release/replay/workflow service families required by the bundled campaign workflow.

facts: cli_families.register_all registers only spec_group and profile_group.
README and bundled campaign-baseline plan describe/invoke campaign, experiment, evaluate, and promote commands.
workflow runtime integration tests inject FakeStepExecutor rather than invoking the real gauntlet CLI.
Repository searches found ExperimentService and PromotionKernel construction only in unit tests in the audited revision.
CommandEvaluator.run dispatches the evaluator subprocess before creating EvaluationResultV1.evaluation_id.
No durable logical evaluation intent/query ID is persisted before evaluator dispatch in this path.
A controller crash after evaluator consumption but before local result persistence can therefore consume the evaluation surface without a durable logical-query record.
ExperimentService.compare accepts caller-supplied baseline_metrics and candidate_metrics arrays.
ComparisonV1 stores derived deltas but does not bind exact evaluation IDs, evaluator digests, split/case IDs, raw paired outcomes, or a logical request digest.
The filesystem LedgerStore is immutable per record, but immutability of a post-hoc derived record does not source-bind its inputs.
Executor durably transitions intent to EXECUTING and persists EffectPlanV1 before adapter execution.
The public external-success-before-local-persistence adversarial test uses a RuntimeError that Executor catches and converts to OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; it is not a real process death.
A true SIGKILL/BaseException after external success but before local result persistence can leave the durable intent in EXECUTING.
Executor.execute only accepts COMMITTED and reconcile only accepts OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, so the audited source lacks an explicit stale-EXECUTING recovery path.
Saga.recover has the stronger rule for started non-idempotent steps: mark unknown/needs-reconciliation and never rerun.
Gauntlet SplitKind has SEARCH, CALIBRATION, PROMOTION only.
The bundled baseline workflow evaluates search and sealed promotion before promotion; there is no fourth terminal OUTER namespace.
GSME reports one sealed test after evolution but its paper explicitly states mechanical enforcement of withholding is future work.

requirements: Create a stable logical_evaluation_id and canonical request digest before any evaluator/provider dispatch.
Bind candidate commit/artifact digest, evaluator identity+version+digest, split, case/trial IDs, scoring protocol, and query/statistical budget reservation to the logical evaluation intent.
Use explicit planned/dispatching/completed/outcome_unknown/reconciled states and never refund a consumed logical query after crash.
Derive paired observations only from immutable evaluation outcomes; ComparisonV2 must reference exact observation/evaluation IDs and cannot accept free metric arrays.
Derive candidate-local anytime-valid evidence and cross-candidate online error control deterministically from the ordered immutable observation log.
Bind promotion to exact artifact identity, evidence-log frontier/hash, statistical policy digest, and verdict.
On restart, stale EXECUTING plus persisted plan and no terminal result must become outcome_unknown/needs-reconciliation, never reset to COMMITTED and never blindly rerun.
Expose a real coordinator/CLI path whose integration test invokes the bundled campaign workflow against the real CLI, not FakeStepExecutor.
Add a fourth OUTER service/namespace that durably rejects every pre-final query and permits a frozen candidate to be evaluated once or cache-only after finalization.

falsification_tests: SIGKILL controller after provider/evaluator accepts but before local outcome persistence; restart must show provider dispatch count=1, logical query spend=1, no refund, same candidate lineage.
SIGKILL after outcome persistence but before statistical update; replay must derive identical e-process/online-FDR state from immutable outcomes.
Same logical evaluation ID with different semantic request digest must fail closed.
Attempt any OUTER query before final frozen-candidate state; request must be durably rejected and query count remain zero.
Run bundled campaign-baseline workflow with the real CLI; every documented command must resolve and execute through production services.
exact_next_action: Search public Gauntlet branches/PRs/releases and other self-improvers for implemented real CLI/service wiring, pre-dispatch logical evaluation intents, stale-EXECUTING reconciliation, replay-derived anytime/online-error state, and a mechanically terminal fourth OUTER. If absent, keep this as a source-bound extension contract and next construct a kill-point equivalence matrix over the audited Gauntlet seams without inventing performance results.
